verdict.rationale: The evidence pack names no first-party, Kit-maintained integration with Stripe, Shopify, Segment or a product database. What it shows instead are developer building blocks: an API for third-party developers to build App Store apps and to import purchase data from e-commerce platforms. It also has a generic marketing line about apps connecting creator tools, with no indication of which systems they cover or who maintains them.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect the platform to my existing stack — Stripe or Shopify, a CDP like Segment, my product database — with maintained first-party integrations
